content:
Priya: Hey team — new lead (data infra) starts Monday. Can we surface a compact manager/HR onboarding checklist + a lean first-week agenda and a 30/60/90 sketch I can share? Also who do I ping if they get blocked on repo or KMS access? :wave:

Sam: @Priya — congrats! I’ll drop a short checklist here you can reuse. Ping me if you want a calendar template. :sparkles:

Sam: Quick manager checklist (high level):
- Day 0: preboard confirm (account created, laptop sent, equipment + shipping)
- Day 1: HR intro + payroll/forms + benefits overview
- Day 1: manager 30-min welcome + team intro + org chart
- Day 1-2: access sweep (okta, github org, cloud console, infra dashboards)
- Day 2-3: dev env + run tests + basic infra walkthrough
- Week 1: schedule 1:1s with direct reports, product, infra, security, and docs owner
- End of week 1: 30-min sync "first-week readout" (what went well, blockers)

Sam: For access blocks: 
- Github/org + repo: ping @Lina (eng buddy) or eng-plat support channel
- Cloud/KMS/HSM: ping @Alex (security) or sec-ops
- Payroll/benefits: people-ops@redwood.com (or me directly)

Lina: I can own the repo/dev env pieces. Priya — please add the new lead to this thread with their GitHub handle before EOD and I’ll pre-stage a branch and a small onboarding task. Also include the machine spec so I can add any micro-ops scripts.

Alex: Heads up — if they need KMS/HSM access for Dedicated/Private testing, we need a signed AUP + manager approval. I can fast-track if you DM the approval. Also schedule the one-hour security intro in week 1.

Priya: Perfect. Can you paste a sample first-week agenda I can send to the hire? Keep it compact, not too intense.

Sam: Here — copy/paste friendly: 

```
First-week agenda (compact):
Mon
- 10:00 AM — Welcome w/People Ops (intro, payroll, benefits) (30m)
- 11:00 AM — Manager welcome + role overview (30m)
- 1:00 PM — Team lunch (virtual/IRL) (30-45m)
- 3:00 PM — IT access check (laptop, accounts, Okta) (30m)

Tue
- 9:30 AM — Dev environment setup + run tests (paired with buddy) (2h)
- 2:00 PM — Product kickoff w/PM (30m)

Wed
- 10:00 AM — Security intro (Alex) (1h)
- 3:00 PM — Infra tour + infra docs walkthrough (1h)

Thu
- Focus: small onboarding task (first PR), team 1:1s, tooling deep-dive

Fri
- 11:00 AM — First-week readout with manager (30m) + next steps
```

Sam: 30/60/90 quick sketch to share: 
- 30 days: onboarded to repo + infra, shipped first minor change, established 1:1 cadence
- 60 days: owning a small project (dev -> deploy), improving runbooks, measurable infra perf baseline
- 90 days: independent delivery on an initiative, clear roadmap items, mentoring new joiners

Lina: For the dev env task I usually give a 30-min "first PR" that touches a tiny infra script — helps confirm access + CI creds. Sample task: clone repo, run `make test` and open a README PR with env notes.

Alex: Add security quick wins to the 30/60/90: verify least-privilege IAM for key roles and rotate test keys used in staging.

HR Bot: New hire profile created: "Leads: Data Infra — start 2026-03-30". Onboarding checklist tasks assigned to: Priya (manager), Sam (people-ops), Lina (eng buddy). Preboarding email sent. Link: https://hr.redwood.internal/onboard/ID-4512

Priya: Thanks all — super helpful. @Lina I’ll DM the GitHub handle now. Sam — could you drop a calendar template (30/60/90 check-ins + first-week blocks) in #cal-templates?

Sam: Will do. Ping me if you want me to schedule the first-week readout. :thumbsup:

Lina: I’ll standby for the handle and pre-stage the task. Welcome aboard in advance! :tada:

Alex: I’ll create the security invite and add it to the hire’s calendar once I get manager approval.

Priya: Awesome — closing loop here. I’ll post the final agenda and send invites by EOD. Thanks! :pray:
